name: Do you handle insurance claims for restoration projects?

mainEntity.name: Do you handle insurance claims for restoration projects?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, City Dweller, LLC can assist clients with their insurance claims for restoration projects. We can help document the damage, provide detailed estimates and reports required by insurance companies, and communicate directly with adjusters to streamline the process. While we don't act as public adjusters, our experience helps ensure that your claim accurately reflects the scope of work needed for proper restoration, alleviating some of the burden during a stressful time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, we assist with documenting damage, providing estimates, and communicating with insurance adjusters to support your restoration claims.
